topics.title: The share card says "join the beta on TestFlight"
The map's explore button opens in place: Qibla · Prayers · Mosques
My masajid: star the mosques you pray at; they sit at the top and never cluster
Jumu'ah at a masjid scores full and shows as "Jumu'ah"; the best grade is "Perfect"
tryIt: Star your masjid on the map (Mosques → its sheet → ☆)
On a Friday, mark Dhuhr there → "✓ Jumu'ah", no grade word, 100
Any other prayer marked in its first 30 min reads "Perfect"

topics.title: The tasbeeh ring is the calm "fine" style by default
Filter your prayer pins to "Only at a masjid"
Duas when you arrive at / leave your masajid (opt-in)
A welcome in Makkah and Madinah
Prayers widget: the ring (centred above the day's five prayers as dots), your choice of bottom corners, score colours on or off, and a times list that goes back to the ring
The time editor opens on the time you saved
Change where you prayed: drag the map under the pin, or type an address
tryIt: Long-press a done prayer → edit time → the location chip → drag the map under the pin
Tap the address → type one → pick a suggestion; it says how far that is from where you marked it
Set → Save

topics.title: The build line (version · build time · commit) under the menu and Settings
Tap a prayer pin: its own page in the sheet, and Edit (time and place) right there
tryIt: Map → Prayers → tap a pin (or a cluster, then a prayer)
The page shows when you prayed, when the window ended, and where
Edit → the sheet grows smoothly into the editor; pan away and "Back to …" brings the pin back

topics.title: Edits keep what the app recorded, so you can put it back
Mosques live in one sheet: the list, a mosque's page inside it, and it shrinks to a bar
tryIt: Map → Mosques → the sheet opens with the list
Tap a mosque → its page slides in; back → the list where you left it
Swipe the sheet down → it shrinks to a bar instead of closing

topics.title: Prayer notifications are planned a week ahead, Fajr included
A prayer that hasn't started has a dashed ring; it fills in when the prayer begins
tryIt: Mark the current prayer → the circle shows NEXT and a dashed ring
Wait for it to begin with the app open → the ring expands into the band, with a soft tap
Dev builds: Settings → My Dev Stuff → Preview prayer begins

topics.title: 99 Names: filter by All · Learning · Known, and reset your progress
Give a zikr task its own name ("After Fajr")
Reminders for zikr tasks: at a time or around a prayer
tryIt: Zikr → New task (or edit one) → Reminder → At a time / Around a prayer
Pick the days → Save
When it fires: Start now opens that task; Later nudges again in 30 min

topics.title: What's new: one card per feature with its latest change; tap for steps, screenshots, the history and feedback to Claude
tryIt: Tap the build line (bottom of ☰ or Settings) → one card per feature, newest change first
Tap a card → try-it steps, screenshots, and every change with its time (dropped ones greyed)
👍 / 👎 / 💬 on a card, add a note or a photo → Send feedback at the top → share / copy it to Claude; it's marked sent

topics.title: The medium Zikr widget fits more tasks and always shows progress
The welcome animation plays only when the app starts fresh
After marking a prayer, a single "Post-salah tasbih?" pill at the bottom
The map's globe toggles Standard ⇄ Satellite, and the map follows light / dark
tryIt: Open the map → tap the globe (top right) → satellite; tap again → standard
Settings → dark (or auto after Maghrib) → the standard map is dark
The ? sits on its own under the globe / locate buttons

topics.title: The app says "zikr" and "Azkar" (never "mantra")
A zikr can hold a voice memo and a photo beside its notes
Eight built-in azkar with their Arabic and a note; locked (name and text), listed apart from yours
New task: the goal is focused; pick a zikr from an Azkar-style list, make one, or start from a zikr's page
tryIt: Zikr page → New task → the number pad is already up
Tap Zikr → the Azkar-style list (search at the bottom); ＋ → the whole new-zikr card → Save → it's picked
Books → Azkar → a zikr → ＋ beside "N tasks" → the task sheet with that zikr locked

topics.title: The green qibla-up button turns the map back and brings you back to your dot
Zikr History: day headers show the time (tap for counts); Edit → select → Delete
The qibla buzz only happens when the Salah circle is on screen
Lock Screen Prayers widget: the ring and bar fill as the window passes; a dashed ring and NEXT before a prayer starts

tryIt: ☰ → 99 Names → tap Known
··· → Reset progress (asks first)

entries.title: Give a zikr task its own name

entries.title: Reminders for zikr tasks
tryIt: Edit a task → Reminder → Around a prayer (e.g. 10 min after Fajr) → Save
When it fires, try Start now / Later / Skip today

entries.title: What's new: tap the build line
tryIt: ☰ menu → tap the build line at the bottom → this page
Tick an item as tested → turn on Untested only

entries.title: Counts no longer include "Allah"

entries.title: The medium Zikr widget fits more tasks and always shows progress

tryIt: Give a task a reminder, then delete the task → its reminders stop
With notifications off, open a task's Reminder → "Notifications are off · Open Settings"
A reminder's actions are now just Start now and Later (30 min)

entries.title: The welcome animation plays only on a fresh start
tryIt: Leave shukr for a while and come back → no welcome
Swipe shukr away in the app switcher, open it again → the welcome plays

Pick a look under Prayer begins → tap Preview prayer begins
The Salah circle shows NEXT, then plays the look with its haptic

entries.title: A prayer that hasn't started has a dashed ring, which fills in when it begins
tryIt: Mark the current prayer → after the green sweep, the ring thins into dashes for the next one
Stay on the Salah page as a prayer starts → the dashes expand into the ring
After Isha, tomorrow's Fajr shows NEXT on the dashed ring (open the list → the score's solid ring)

entries.title: Tomorrow's Fajr countdown reads "in 8h 5m"
tryIt: After all five are marked, the circle's Fajr says "in 8h 5m" (no comma)
Tap it → its window, e.g. 5:56 - 7:10 AM

entries.title: Post-salah: only the bottom pill
tryIt: Mark a prayer → after the sweep, the "Post-salah tasbih?" pill at the bottom (no in-circle offer, no top pill)
Settings → My Dev Stuff no longer has a Post-salah prompt picker

entries.title: Map Modes sheet (Standard / Satellite cards, Traffic, Labels)
tryIt: Open the map → tap the globe (top right) → pick Satellite
Turn Labels off for pure imagery, or Traffic on
Close and reopen the app → the map keeps your choice

entries.title: The map's style button is a globe: tap for Satellite, tap again for Standard
tryIt: Open the map → tap the globe (top right) → satellite; tap again → standard
Close and reopen the app → the map keeps your choice

entries.title: The map follows the app's light / dark / auto setting; ? has its own button
tryIt: Settings → switch to dark (or auto after Maghrib) → open the map → the standard map is dark
The ? sits on its own under the globe / locate buttons

entries.title: "Mantra" is now "zikr" everywhere; the library is "Azkar"
tryIt: Zikr page → the books button → History | Azkar
Open a zikr → "Edit zikr", "No tasks use this zikr"
Pause a session → "choose a zikr" / "Edit zikr"

entries.title: A zikr can hold a voice memo and a photo beside its notes
tryIt: Open a zikr → the three icons left of the notes box: notes / voice memo / photo — tapping swaps the box in place
Voice memo → Tap to record (asks for the mic once, max 2 min) → play, 0.75×, loop; ··· to record again or delete
Photo → Add a photo or Take one → tap it to zoom; hold for replace / remove
Start that zikr, pause → the memo's ▶︎ and the photo's thumbnail are on the pause card
Music playing? It carries on after the memo

entries.title: The built-in azkar have their Arabic and a note, and there are four more
tryIt: Zikr page → books → Azkar: Alhamdulillah, Subhanallah, Allahu Akbar, Astaghfirullah now show their Arabic
New: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu, SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad, Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil
Open one → the note says what it means and where it's from (long notes scroll in the box)
Anything you'd already written in a built-in's text or notes is kept

entries.title: New task: the goal is focused, a ＋ for a new zikr, and New task from a zikr's page
tryIt: Zikr page → New task → the number pad is already up
Tap Zikr → ＋ (top right) → the whole new-zikr card (name, text, notes, memo, photo) → Save → you're back with it picked
Open a zikr (books → Azkar) → ＋ beside "N tasks" → the task sheet with that zikr locked
A zikr with no tasks shows a dashed New task circle instead

entries.title: Choosing a zikr looks like the Azkar page
tryIt: New task → tap Zikr → "Choose a zikr" with ✕ and ＋, the same rows as Azkar (text, pace), search at the bottom
The zikr already picked has a green check
Search also finds words in a zikr's text or notes

entries.title: The green qibla-up button also brings you back to your dot
tryIt: Open the map → turn it with two fingers, zoom out and drag away
Tap the green arrow under locate → one move back to your dot, qibla-up, at the qibla zoom
In prayer spots / mosques the red needle still only turns the map north

entries.title: What's new v2: cards per feature, detail page with screenshots and a timeline, feedback back to Claude
tryIt: Open What's new → cards grouped by feature (e.g. Map style has 3 changes)
Tap Map style → the dropped Map Modes sheet is greyed in Changes
Tap 👎 on a card, write a line → Send feedback → Copy → the card says sent

entries.title: Voice memo: takes are never lost, and it stops when it should
tryIt: Record a memo and let it run to 2:00, or take a call / go home mid-take → the take is kept
Play a memo on the pause card → Resume → it stops; your music comes back when you pause it
Start the memo on the ✎ sheet while the pause card's plays → only one plays

entries.title: Photos are prepared in the background (no hitch when picking a big one)
tryIt: Add a big photo or take one with the camera → the card doesn't stutter

entries.title: A new zikr can't be swiped away with something in it; Delete zikr while editing; no double ＋
tryIt: Picker ＋ → type a name → swipe down: it stays; Cancel asks "Discard this zikr?"
Save a new zikr → the card closes, then the picker, and it's picked
Open one of your azkar → ✎ → Delete zikr at the bottom (says what happens to its tasks and sessions)
A zikr with no tasks shows only the dashed New task circle; the ＋ appears once it has one

entries.title: Built-ins are locked and listed apart: a Built-in section above Your azkar
tryIt: Books → Azkar → "Built-in" then "Your azkar"
Open a built-in → ✎ → the name and full text are locked (a small lock), notes / memo / photo still edit
Built-ins can't be swiped to delete and have no Delete button

entries.title: History: day time in the headers, Edit to select and delete sessions; no more row swipes
tryIt: Books → History → each day's header shows its time; tap one → every header shows counts (remembered)
Edit (top right) → tick sessions → Delete N sessions → confirm; totals and today's tasks update
Rows no longer swipe; tap one for Zikr · Pace

entries.title: More air between NEXT and the prayer name (circle, next Fajr, widget)
tryIt: Mark the current prayer → NEXT sits clearly above the next prayer's name
Home-screen Prayers widget: same gap, scaled

entries.title: The qibla buzz only happens when the Salah circle is on screen

Zikr page, Settings, History, the task sheets, the map or a tasbeeh session → no buzz

entries.title: Lock Screen Prayers widget: ring and bar fill up; dashed ring + NEXT for the next prayer

During a prayer the ring and the bar grow as time passes
Before a prayer starts (or after you've marked one) the small one shows a dashed ring with NEXT

entries.title: NEXT is a small tag set apart above the name; dev toggle to try the dashed ring alone; Lock Screen: ring only

Settings → My Dev Stuff → Next prayer → "Dashed ring only" → no NEXT anywhere (app and home-screen widget)
Lock Screen widget: a prayer that hasn't started shows just the dashed ring

entries.title: A voice memo that's still opening never starts after Resume; a double tap opens it once

entries.title: Send feedback shares a .md file with your photos; Copy asks before marking sent
